items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Some guy went over to Russia and Putin took his ring.

ctx.x: Anyway, not him specifically, but that era and stuff. But what I’m getting at was ­ he came to see me in Monterrey. He’s a big guy, about 6’ 8”. He was a football player. He told me something really deep. Some guy went over to Russia and Putin took his ring. It was an owner.
